description:
Ready to take your career global? 
 
 Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for Software Test Analyst I (Automation Testing,C#,Specflow) to join our ever-evolving Checkout Products team and help shape the future of global commerce.
 
 What you’ll own 
 Develops, maintains and upgrades manual or automated test scripts, utilities, simulators, data sets and other programmatic test tools required to execute test plans.
 Performs usability testing for total system performance, reliability, scalability and security. 
 Effectively communicates testing activities and findings in oral and written forms.
Controls and manages own daily test activities.
 Provides internal quality assurance.
 Supports test lead to identify risks and develops mitigation strategies.
 Organizes and maintains the test script library.
 Other related duties assigned as needed
 
 What you’ll bring 
 1-3 Years of overall Test Engineer Experience
 1-3 years backend API testing
 1-3 years Automation testing experience with C# and Specflow/Reqnroll framework.
 Strong leadership qualities as a test lead and ability to speak out when needed
 
 It’s is a bonus if you have: 
 Payments industry experience
 
 About the team 
 Our inclusive and global teams win together every day. We’re proud to have the best minds in the industry, who you can learn from as you grow your career. The people, the energy, the connections – it’s unmatched. Come and be part of an ever-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.
 
 What makes a Globalpayer? 
Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative – always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.
Does this sound like you? Then you sound like a Globalpayer.
 Apply now to take your career global.
 
 #LI-ALKAYADAV
years_evidence: 1-3 Years of overall Test Engineer Experience
